037/**
038 * Basic implementation of the {@link HttpResponse} interface for error responses.
039 *
040 * <p>
041 * Although this class implements the various setters defined on the {@link HttpResponse} interface, it's in general
042 * going to be more efficient to set the status/headers/content of this bean through the builder.
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * Immutability is expressed with the "funnel + nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot" paradigm: every mutator (fluent
046 * setter and {@code void} interface mutator) routes through the single protected {@link #modify(Runnable)} choke-point,
047 * and each concrete leaf gets a nested {@code X.Unmodifiable} whose only behavioral override is a throwing
048 * {@code modify(...)}.  A leaf's {@link #unmodifiable()} factory returns a point-in-time snapshot of type
049 * {@code X.Unmodifiable}; any attempt to set a property on it throws an {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.
050 *
051 * <p>
052 * This is a {@link Throwable}-rooted hierarchy, so (unlike {@link BasicHttpResponse}) it cannot be a self-typed (CRTP)
053 * root — JLS &sect;8.1.2 forbids a generic {@code Throwable}.  The funnel therefore returns the base type and each leaf
054 * keeps its covariant setter overrides.
055 *
056 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
057 *    <li class='warn'>Beans are not thread safe unless they're marked as unmodifiable.
058 * </ul>
059 *
060 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
061 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauRestCommon">juneau-rest-common Basics</a>
062 * </ul>
063 *
064 * @serial exclude
065 */
066@Marshalled(as=MarshalledAs.STRING)
067@SuppressWarnings({
068   "java:S115", // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., PROP_status)
069   "java:S110" // Deep exception-hierarchy inheritance is structural and intentional; flattening would break the HTTP-response exception model.
070})
071public class BasicHttpException extends BasicRuntimeException implements HttpResponse {

083   @SuppressWarnings({

085      "java:S1165"  // Cannot be final; setStatusLine() replaces it entirely via statusLine = value.copy()
086   })
087   transient BasicStatusLine statusLine = new BasicStatusLine();
088   @SuppressWarnings({

090      "java:S1165"  // Cannot be final; setContent() replaces it via content = value
091   })
092   transient HttpEntity content;

094   /**

101   /**
102    * Constructor.
103    *
104    * <p>
105    * This is the constructor used when parsing an HTTP response.
106    *
107    * @param response The HTTP response being parsed.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
108    */
109   public BasicHttpException(HttpResponse response) {
110      super((Throwable)null);
111      assertArgNotNull(ARG_response, response);
112      var h = response.getLastHeader("Thrown");
113      if (nn(h)) {
114         var partsOpt = thrown(h.getValue()).asParts();
115         if (partsOpt.isPresent() && !partsOpt.get().isEmpty()) // HTT: isPresent() is always true here — thrown(String) returns null (NPE on the .asParts() call above, before this line) whenever its arg is null, and Thrown.of(non-null) always yields a present Optional; the false side of isPresent() is unreachable without a prior NPE.
116            setMessage(partsOpt.get().get(0).getMessage());
117      }
118      setHeaders(response.getAllHeaders());
119      setContent(response.getEntity());
120      setStatusCode(response.getStatusLine().getStatusCode());
121   }

170   /**
171    * Copy constructor.
172    *
173    * <p>
174    * The mutable sub-beans are deep-copied by <b>direct field assignment</b>, never through a funneled setter.  This is
175    * the snapshot path used by {@link #unmodifiable()}: the constructor runs inside an {@code Unmodifiable} instance
176    * whose {@link #modify(Runnable)} already throws, so a setter-based copy would blow up during construction.
177    *
178    * @param copyFrom The bean to copy.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
179    */
180   protected BasicHttpException(BasicHttpException copyFrom) {
181      super(copyFrom.getCause(), "%s", copyFrom.getMessage());
182      statusLine = copyFrom.statusLine.copy();
183      headers = copyFrom.headers.copy();
184      content = copyFrom.content;
185   }

218   /**
219    * Returns all error messages from all errors in this stack.
220    *
221    * <p>
222    * Typically useful if you want to render all the error messages in the stack, but don't want to render all the
223    * stack traces too.
224    *
225    * @param scrubForXssVulnerabilities
226    *    If <jk>true</jk>, replaces <js>'&lt;'</js>, <js>'&gt;'</js>, and <js>'&amp;'</js> characters with spaces.
227    * @return All error messages from all errors in this stack.
228    */
229   public String getFullStackMessage(boolean scrubForXssVulnerabilities) {
230      var msg = getMessage();
231      StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
232      if (nn(msg)) {
233         if (scrubForXssVulnerabilities)
234            msg = msg.replace('<', ' ').replace('>', ' ').replace('&', ' ');
235         sb.append(msg);
236      }
237      Throwable e = getCause();
238      while (nn(e)) {
239         msg = e.getMessage();
240         if (nn(msg) && scrubForXssVulnerabilities)
241            msg = msg.replace('<', ' ').replace('>', ' ').replace('&', ' ');
242         var cls = cns(e);
243         if (msg == null)
244            sb.append(f("\nCaused by (%s)", cls));
245         else
246            sb.append(f("\nCaused by (%s): %s", cls, msg));
247         e = e.getCause();
248      }
249      return sb.toString();
250   }

293   /**
294    * Returns the root cause of this exception.
295    *
296    * <p>
297    * The root cause is the first exception in the init-cause parent chain that's not one of the following:
298    * <ul>
299    *    <li>{@link BasicHttpException}
300    *    <li>{@link InvocationTargetException}
301    * </ul>
302    *
303    * @return The root cause of this exception, or <jk>null</jk> if no root cause was found.
304    */
305   public Throwable getRootCause() {
306      Throwable t = this;
307      while (nn(t)) {
308         if (! (t instanceof BasicHttpException || t instanceof InvocationTargetException))
309            return t;
310         t = t.getCause();
311      }
312      return null;
313   }

318   @Override /* Overridden from Object */
319   public boolean equals(Object o) {
320      // D3 content equality.  The 'content' HttpEntity is deliberately excluded: it is a wrapper without value
321      // semantics (two StringEntity instances of the same text are not equal), and it is derived from the message
322      // (getEntity() lazily builds stringEntity(getMessage())), which is already compared here.
323      return o instanceof BasicHttpException other && eq(this, other, (x, y) ->
324         eq(x.statusLine, y.statusLine) && eq(x.headers, y.headers) && eq(x.getMessage(), y.getMessage()));
325   }

561   /**

568    * modifiable unless it was already unmodifiable).

581   /**
582    * Asserts that the specified HTTP response has the same status code as the one on the status line of this bean.
583    *
584    * @param response The HTTP response to check.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
585    * @throws AssertionError If status code is not what was expected.
586    */
587   protected void assertStatusCode(HttpResponse response) throws AssertionError {
588      assertArgNotNull(ARG_response, response);
589      int expected = getStatusLine().getStatusCode();
590      int actual = response.getStatusLine().getStatusCode();
591      assertInteger(actual).setMsg("Unexpected status code.  Expected:[%s], Actual:[%s]", expected, actual).is(expected);
592   }

594   /**
595    * Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.
596    *
597    * <p>
598    * Every mutator (fluent setter and {@code void} interface mutator) routes through this method.  The nested
599    * {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot overrides only this method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with
600    * a single override.  Because this is a {@link Throwable}-rooted hierarchy (no CRTP self-type), the funnel returns
601    * the base type.
602    *
603    * @param mutation The state change to apply.
604    * @return This object.
605    */
606   protected BasicHttpException modify(Runnable mutation) {
607      mutation.run();
608      return this;
609   }
610
611   /**
612    * Deep-freeze hook invoked from the nested {@code Unmodifiable} constructor after the snapshot copy completes.
613    *
614    * <p>
615    * The mutable sub-beans are frozen here by <b>direct field assignment</b> (never via a setter, which would route
616    * through the throwing {@link #modify(Runnable)} and blow up during construction).  A leaf that adds its own mutable
617    * sub-bean overrides this method (calling {@code super.freeze()} first).
618    */
619   protected void freeze() {
620      statusLine = statusLine.unmodifiable();   // DIRECT field write — must NOT use setStatusLine(...)
621      headers = headers.unmodifiable();         // DIRECT field write — snapshot the copied HeaderList.
622   }
623
624   /**
625    * Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing {@link BasicHttpException}.
626    *
627    * <p>
628    * Its only behavioral override is {@link #modify(Runnable)}, which throws — because all mutation is funneled through
629    * {@code modify(...)}, this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.
630    */
631   public static class Unmodifiable extends BasicHttpException implements UnmodifiableBean {
632
633      private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
634
635      /**
636       * Constructor.
637       *
638       * @param copyFrom The exception to snapshot.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
639       */
640      @SuppressWarnings({
641         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
642      })
643      protected Unmodifiable(BasicHttpException copyFrom) {
644         super(copyFrom);
645         freeze();
646      }
647
648      @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpException */
649      protected BasicHttpException modify(Runnable mutation) {
650         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
651      }
652   }
